falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the S&P 500 closes at a new 52-week high and is up at least 3.5% from the current close, while the share of S&P 500 members above their 50-day moving average rises by at least 8 percentage points.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Breadth-confirmed upside continuation breaks the mini_top_2019_jun analogue and shows HOLD/UNKNOWN was wrong; the phase was markup, not an unresolved top.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the S&P 500 closes down at least 6% from the current close on a day when the VIX closes above 28.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The drawdown is too deep and volatility-confirmed to be a June-2019-style mini top, so both the pattern match and the HOLD/UNKNOWN call fail; the correct signal was risk-off.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days US high-yield OAS moves at least 50 basis points in either direction (widen or tighten) from the current level.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Credit has resolved into a clear risk regime, so an UNKNOWN phase and HOLD signal are falsified; the macro state was identifiable and actionable.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
